verdict.rationale: Idempotent retries are a fair axis for a payments API, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions idempotency keys, safe retries or duplicate-charge prevention. Error diagnostics in the meta object (paystack-docs-6) are a related feature and do not deliver this story. The fraud protection claim (paystack-docs-14) is also unrelated to duplicate-request handling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges
